cand.excerpt: Ranks on verified event mechanism and geography; penalized where venue is committed or hotel sourcing is unconfirmed.

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Officially announced 10th edition: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland; within the requested horizon and future as of 16 November 2026. These are workshop activity dates, not the 5 October 2026 announcement date. Registration opened 1 October 2026; early-bird deadline 31 January 2027. No later edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
verifyPrev.venueText: 2027 scientific meeting venue publicly confirmed at Agroscope Changins – Aula. Separate pre-reserved accommodation is referenced, but hotel identities and contract scope are unresolved.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: NO_NAMED_COMMERCIAL_CONTACT_WITH_SOURCE remains unresolved. No reviewed source identifies a named organizer, meetings manager or accommodation buyer for the 2027 edition. The verified edition-specific enquiry address is info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch; its individual recipient and purchasing authority are not disclosed. Johann Marmy appears only in an image copyright credit, not an organizer role.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland; organized by Agroscope. The 5 October 2026 date is the announcement publication date, not the workshop date.
findings.venueCommitments: Scientific meeting confirmed at Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Switzerland. This is a research-centre venue, not a competing hotel.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The official edition website gives 31 March 2027 as the deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms. Hotel identities, room quantities, contracting party and availability for additional suppliers remain unverified. Hotel sourcing must not be labelled open.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch requesting the name and role of the GDPM 2027 accommodation coordinator and hotel-contract decision maker. Ask whether additional Founex accommodation can be considered alongside the pre-reserved hotels, and what transfer requirements apply. Do not send a presumed-open room-block proposal before that confirmation.
